subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should WebChat provider-backed voice be split into Gateway Read aloud first and editable batch push-to-talk STT through `tools.media.audio`, with browser/realtime Talk kept as a distinct explicit mode?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but the STT path affects microphone UX, fallback semantics, provider credentials, and whether WebChat voice is batch dictation, realtime Talk, or both.

options.title: Split TTS and batch STT
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, review or replace the Gateway read-aloud PR for TTS, and handle editable batch dictation as a separate `tools.media.audio` Gateway flow.

options.title: Narrow to TTS only
options.body: Make this issue only the provider-backed read-aloud tracker and let the editable dictation issue own the STT product surface.

options.title: Pause for unified voice design
options.body: Defer both slices until maintainers define one WebChat voice model across Talk, dictation, TTS settings, and fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Split TTS and batch STT
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, review or replace the Gateway read-aloud PR for TTS, and handle editable batch dictation as a separate `tools.media.audio` Gateway flow.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal from the prior WebChat dictation implementation and the open Gateway read-aloud candidate.
